delivery_evidence: PD = two 6-hour group trainings + three individual coaching sessions (7.5-8.5 hrs); 'Intervention teachers attended group trainings at one of four locations' (p.42-43 PD section; design p.37). Face-to-face.
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes = Gates-MacGinitie Reading Tests (GMRT) Vocabulary & Comprehension subtests, a published broad standardized reading battery not tailored to the software (Table 4.1, p.55).
curriculum_evidence: PD trains teachers to adopt and use the Thinking Reader digital reading-comprehension software (3 digital novels) as a partial substitute for regular ELA instruction; a new instructional-materials package (design/intervention section, p.37-42).
outcome_timing_evidence: GMRT administered spring 2009, end of the single 2008-09 implementation year; no later wave (Table 4.1, p.55; Exec Summary p.5).
